type: Two-stage physical GDS generation and post-layout verification; SKY130 named KLayout layer palette discovery
changes: Generate GDS and Verify Existing Layout are separate GUI/CLI actions
LibreLane Classic flow stops after KLayout.StreamOut, later resumes after that stage without new synthesis or place/route
DLS equivalence can be deferred and tested from frozen source snapshot during verification
SHA256 protects reused RTL, config, and GDS against unnoticed changes
KLayout opens named SKY130 layers using .lyp discovered from local/WSL PDK
Clear GUIDE_ONLY status for CO floorplan region SVG; no spurious claim of mapped-cell placement
limitations: Module separation is NOT physically enforced for flattened Apollo/Tiny8 designs
Live LibreLane Windows WSL --to / --from resume not tested on user computer
LibreLane preliminary checkers prior to stream-out still run in layout mode
GDS generated without post-layout checks is not foundry signoff
